I went to the showroom for a thorough check up of the car and I was advised it was a flooded car i.e. it had been in flood water and because of it you are having this problem. I called the uncle and said about the issues, he as a smooth talker told me beta I have been just operated upon and now that you bought the car which will stay with you for a long time why not do the repair work ,so I asked about the six month warranty and he bluntly said I can't do anything about it since when you took the car it was fine and does not count into the warranty. I was stunned and felt miserable. I have spent 50000 on the car to repair the problem. My problem is that the trust once broken will always stay broken. I will never recommend buying a second hand car from OM motors ever to anyone. If you still want to buy it , then please ensure to get a experienced mechanic along so that you don't get cheated like I was. Because blindly trusted whatever I was told about the car. I just regret this whole experience. I wish it would never had happened. I am have added the picture of the cars with the number plate depicting that I bought it from OM motors to verify the authenticity of this post. I am a genuine customer who does not wish for someone else to go through what I went through and thus I am providing a detailed description.

featured_reviews.name: Mihir Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Varsha ma'am, Mr Sameer and the owner/manager were very helpful. I had been there for a silver Hyundai verna car. Car was is a good condition and with genuine km (checked at service centre). I took two weeks to finalize and the car was sold on the day I called to finalize. However I appreciate the way they are handling customers, over 2 weeks I rec'd only two calls, both times to check if i was still interested in the car. They were not pushy at all. The Owner/manager and Mr Sameer patiently answered all my queries to satisfaction. They were open in discussing and checking the car to ascertain if there was any accidental history (no history in this car). I will surely recommend them to customers looking to buy a used car. Thank you for a pleasant experience.
